import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import timeit
from pandas import Period

def test_strftime_none():
    """Test strftime(None) for monthly frequency - most common case"""
    period_data = [Period('2012-06-01', freq='M') for _ in range(10000)]
    t = timeit.timeit(lambda: [p.strftime(None) for p in period_data], number=5)
    print(f"Monthly strftime(None): {t:.4f}s for 50000 calls")
    return t

def test_strftime_with_format():
    """Test strftime with a format string without special patterns"""
    period_data = [Period('2012-06-01', freq='M') for _ in range(10000)]
    t = timeit.timeit(lambda: [p.strftime('%Y-%m') for p in period_data], number=5)
    print(f"Monthly strftime('%Y-%m'): {t:.4f}s for 50000 calls")
    return t

def test_strftime_with_special():
    """Test strftime with special patterns (should use slow path)"""
    period_data = [Period('2012-06-01', freq='Q') for _ in range(10000)]
    t = timeit.timeit(lambda: [p.strftime('%F-Q%q') for p in period_data], number=5)
    print(f"Quarterly strftime('%F-Q%q'): {t:.4f}s for 50000 calls")
    return t

def test_daily_strftime():
    """Test daily frequency strftime(None)"""
    period_data = [Period('2012-06-01', freq='D') for _ in range(10000)]
    t = timeit.timeit(lambda: [p.strftime(None) for p in period_data], number=5)
    print(f"Daily strftime(None): {t:.4f}s for 50000 calls")
    return t

def test_correctness():
    """Verify correctness of output"""
    # Monthly
    p = Period('2012-06-15', freq='M')
    assert p.strftime(None) == '2012-06', f"Expected '2012-06', got '{p.strftime(None)}'"
    assert p.strftime('%Y-%m') == '2012-06', f"Expected '2012-06', got '{p.strftime('%Y-%m')}'"
    
    # Daily
    p = Period('2012-06-15', freq='D')
    assert p.strftime(None) == '2012-06-15', f"Expected '2012-06-15', got '{p.strftime(None)}'"
    
    # Quarterly with special patterns
    p = Period('2012-06-15', freq='Q')
    assert p.strftime('%F-Q%q') == '2012-Q2', f"Expected '2012-Q2', got '{p.strftime('%F-Q%q')}'"
    
    # Yearly
    p = Period('2012', freq='A')
    assert p.strftime(None) == '2012', f"Expected '2012', got '{p.strftime(None)}'"
    
    # Hourly
    p = Period('2012-06-15 14:30', freq='H')
    assert p.strftime(None) == '2012-06-15 14:00', f"Expected '2012-06-15 14:00', got '{p.strftime(None)}'"
    
    # Millisecond (has special pattern %l)
    p = Period('2012-06-15 14:30:45.123', freq='L')
    result = p.strftime(None)
    assert '.123' in result, f"Expected '.123' in '{result}'"
    
    print("All correctness tests passed!")
